title: Z9 connection — Five original right-side systems have unique rational solutions
milestone_description: For every n>=1 and r=0,...,4, there exists exactly one rational polynomial pair P,q of natural degrees at most four and nine satisfying the full original polynomial identity with the genuine scaled three-factor Z_n(u)(u-n-1)^r target. Rational-function, HasSum and five-output parameter transport are separate results.
